title: Bug Hunt mismatched form state
objective: Find and remove duplicated form state, stale previews, and uncontrolled-to-controlled mismatches.
predict: Typing must update both preview and submitted payload from the same registered field value. Reset should clear both.
expectedBehavior: Type, reset and programmatically update the field; preview and submitted payload must be consistent, with no independent useState shadow.
commonFailure: Separate useState preview and RHF input values drift after reset or programmatic update.
securityBoundary: Treat displayed form previews as user content; React text interpolation escapes text, while innerHTML would introduce an XSS risk.
